subject.title: [Feature]: 3 architecture improvements — bootstrap relevance, incremental compaction, observation extraction

question: Which part of this broad architecture request should OpenClaw core own first, and which parts should move to existing plugin/context-engine trackers?
rationale: Current main partially addresses AGENTS.md bootstrap relevance and has compaction/context-engine plugin surfaces, but choosing a generic bootstrap relevance algorithm or promoting observation extraction into core is a product boundary decision.

options.title: Split Into Tracks
options.body: Create or confirm separate focused trackers for bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction, then retire this umbrella once links are clear.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Use this issue only as a parent architecture discussion and keep automated repair work blocked until maintainers prioritize one track.

options.title: Supersede After Relinking
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers confirm bootstrap relevance and compaction are fully covered elsewhere and observation extraction belongs outside core.

recommendation.title: Split Into Tracks
recommendation.body: Create or confirm separate focused trackers for bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction, then retire this umbrella once links are clear.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue and has current-history ties to the bootstrap/runtime paths where the remaining core decision lives.
